items.what: Chart pages: the slowest 10% of real loads take 14s — phones 5.01s vs desktop 9.34s (48% of loads on phones); the server answers in 0.27s and candles in 0.08s (HIT) — the time is on the visitor's side. Desktops are slower than phones, so it is not phone CPU — something desktop loads (more candles, panels, a far country) is the lead. A headless flood is on (US: 177 raw vs ~16.1, 4 stayed, GB: 62 raw vs ~8.9, 0 stayed) — its loads pollute the desktop number; trust phones until it stops. Most slow-load time sits in: mobile/US 3.44s ×355, desktop/IN 20s ×51, desktop/IR 47s ×10, desktop/US 1.83s ×248. Needs a build session to profile one slow load.
items.why: speed brain asks for it
